title: Hassabis's Secret Plans for AI Before Resigning, Atomic Energy Agency: Has Communicated with the US Treasury Secretary, Benchmarking the International Atomic Energy Agency

content_html:
According to the Wall Street Journal, sources said that a few weeks before stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind, Demis Hassabis had discussions with U.S. government officials and other AI lab leaders about establishing an independent AI industry safety organization. As a co-founder of DeepMind and a pioneer in machine learning, Hassabis has increasingly devoted his time to promoting the creation of organizations that develop safety mechanisms and best practices for general artificial intelligence. When discussing this proposed institution with peers, he compared it to the International Atomic Energy Agency—a non-governmental oversight organization that promotes cooperation in nuclear energy.

Sources said that in early summer this year, Hassabis discussed all aspects of the plan with senior officials from the Trump administration, including U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessette and one of President Trump's senior technology advisors, Michael Kratsios. A Google spokesperson said the company believes ensuring the safety of advanced AI models is "crucial for society," and Hassabis has a unique advantage in advancing this goal, stating that he will take on a new role at Google and strategically focus more on scientific breakthroughs and shaping the direction of AGI.

Introducing a "Frontier-Level" Labeling System, Modeled After the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority

In mid-July this year, Hassabis posted on X, suggesting that the United States should establish an industry-funded "standardizing body" to help assess the safety of AI models. He said that the institution could operate similarly to the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, a self-regulatory organization established during the Great Depression to oversee brokerage firms, funded by the financial industry. According to his plan, federal agencies and national laboratories under the U.S. Department of Energy would collaborate with AI companies to test models in "fields related to national security" and establish a certification system, granting models that meet specific standards a "Frontier-Level" label.

Last week, Google announced major management changes at DeepMind, with Hassabis stepping down as CEO and being succeeded by his deputy, Corinna Kretzschmar, while Hassabis himself took on the roles of Chairman of DeepMind and Chief Scientist at Alphabet. This "succession plan" before his resignation clearly indicates preparations for the next chapter in AI governance—transitioning from leading the world's most advanced AI laboratory to attempting to build a safety governance framework for the entire industry. Hassabis is shifting from a technical leader to a systems designer, and if this proposed institution comes to fruition, it could have a profound impact on the global AI regulatory landscape.

content_html_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，消息人士称，在辞去谷歌 DeepMind 首席执行官职务的几周前，Demis Hassabis 曾与美国政府官员和其他 AI 实验室负责人讨论建立独立的 AI 行业安全组织的事宜。 作为 DeepMind 的联合创始人和机器学习领域的先驱，哈萨比斯越来越多地致力于推动创建通用人工智能安全机制和最佳实践的组织。 在与同行讨论这个拟议的机构时，他将其与国际原子能机构（一个促进核能合作的非政府监督组织）进行了比较。

消息人士称，今年初夏，哈萨比斯与特朗普政府高级官员讨论了该计划的各个方面，其中包括美国财政部长斯科特·贝塞特和特朗普总统的高级技术顾问之一迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯。 谷歌发言人表示，该公司相信确保先进人工智能模型的安全“对社会至关重要”，而哈萨比斯在推进这一目标方面拥有独特的优势，并表示他将在谷歌担任新职务，并在战略上更多地关注科学突破和塑造通用人工智能的方向。

效仿金融业监管机构推出“边境级”标签系统

今年7月中旬，哈萨比斯在X上发帖，建议美国应该建立一个由行业资助的“标准化机构”，帮助评估AI模型的安全性。 他表示，该机构的运作方式可以类似于金融业监管局，金融业监管局是大萧条期间成立的一个自律组织，负责监管由金融业资助的经纪公司。 根据他的计划，美国能源部下属的联邦机构和国家实验室将与人工智能公司合作，测试“与国家安全相关领域”的模型，并建立认证体系，为符合特定标准的模型授予“前沿级”标签。

上周，谷歌宣布了 DeepMind 的重大管理层变动，哈萨比斯辞去首席执行官职务，由副手 Corinna Kretzschmar 接任，而哈萨比斯本人则担任 DeepMind 董事长和 Alphabet 首席科学家。 这份卸任前的“接班计划”明确表明了他正在为人工智能治理的下一章做准备——从领导全球最先进的人工智能实验室转向尝试构建整个行业的安全治理框架。 哈萨比斯正在从技术领导者转变为系统设计师，如果这个拟议的机构得以实现，它可能会对全球人工智能监管格局产生深远的影响。
